# Plugins reference

The system plugins compiled into Nocterm, and the panels and widgets they and the shell offer to the window. A contribution's placement is a hint: the Default layout places it by zone and order, and a saved layout may place it elsewhere. Every plugin is enabled by default; `[plugins].disabled` lists those switched off, and a required plugin ignores it.

## Panel groups

Panels in one group exclude each other. The primary group holds the sidebar.

| Group | Title | Primary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `navigation` | Sidebar | yes |
| `assistant` | Assistant | no |

## Shell

Contributions of the window shell and its core features. They are not plugins and cannot be switched off.

| Id | Kind | Title | Zone | Order | Group | Auto | Pinned |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connections.servers` | panel | Connections | left | 10 | `navigation` | show | no |
| `files.explorer` | panel | Explorer | left | 20 | `navigation` | show | no |
| `workspace.notifications` | widget | Notifications | right | 10 | none | show | yes |
| `files.transfers` | widget | Transfers | right | 20 | none | show | no |
| `workspace.local-terminal` | widget | Local Terminal | right | 30 | none | show | no |

## Monitor

Plugin `monitor`. Required: no. Enabled by default: yes. Own settings page: `monitor`, reached from Settings ▸ Plugins.

CPU and memory of the active environment in the status bar

| Id | Kind | Title | Zone | Order | Group | Auto | Pinned |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monitor.summary` | widget | Monitor | left | 60 | none | show | no |

### Settings: Status bar

Shown for `monitor.summary`.

| Key | Label | Kind | Default | Options or range | Stored in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status_bar` | Metrics in the status bar | multi-choice | `cpu`, `memory` | `cpu` (CPU), `cores` (CPU cores), `memory` (Memory), `swap` (Swap), `load` (Load average), `uptime` (Uptime), `temperature` (Temperature), `disks` (Disk space), `network` (Network), `disk_io` (Disk I/O); at most 10, kept in the order chosen | `[monitor].status_bar` |

## Clock

Plugin `clock`. Required: no. Enabled by default: yes.

The local time in the status bar

| Id | Kind | Title | Zone | Order | Group | Auto | Pinned |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clock.time` | widget | Clock | right | 25 | none | tray | no |

### Settings: Display

Shown for `clock.time`.

| Key | Label | Kind | Default | Options or range | Stored in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | Time format | choice | `hour24` | `hour24` (24-hour), `hour12` (12-hour) | `[clock].format` |
| `seconds` | Show seconds | toggle | off | on or off | `[clock].seconds` |
| `date` | Show the date | toggle | off | on or off | `[clock].date` |
